mapper.sql: id, realm_id, user_id, permission_id, grant_type, reason, expired_time, granted_by, deleted, created_time, updated_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM iam_user_permission WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
SELECT FROM iam_user_permission WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY created_time DESC, id DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM iam_user_permission WHERE permission_id = #{permissionId} AND deleted = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_user_permission(realm_id, user_id, permission_id, grant_type, reason, expired_time, granted_by, deleted) VALUES (#{realmId}, #{userId}, #{permissionId}, #{grantType}, #{reason}, #{expiredTime}, #{grantedBy}, FALSE) ON CONFLICT (user_id, permission_id) WHERE deleted = FALSE DO UPDATE SET realm_id = EXCLUDED.realm_id, grant_type = EXCLUDED.grant_type, reason = EXCLUDED.reason, expired_time = EXCLUDED.expired_time, granted_by = EXCLUDED.granted_by, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_user_permission SET deleted = TRUE, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
